_prune_cache() {
  local dir=$1
  local budget_kb=$2
  [[ -d "$dir" ]] || return 0
  local total
  total=$(du -sk -- "$dir" | cut -f1)
  local -a entries
  while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
    entries+=("$f")
  done < <(find "$dir" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print0 | xargs -0 stat -f '%m %N' 2>/dev/null | sort -n | cut -d' ' -f2- | tr '\n' '\0' | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do printf '%s\0' "$f"; done)
  for f in "${entries[@]}"; do
    (( total <= budget_kb )) && break
    local sz
    sz=$(du -sk -- "$f" | cut -f1)
    rm -rf -- "$f"
    total=$(( total - sz ))
  done
}
